paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Korshai: Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 10, halakhah 8; [Horayot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.13b.14) has ben Korshi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Shabbat 10:8 and has Korshai. The matching notice in [the consulted Yerushalmi, Shabbat 10:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shabbat.10.5.2) reads Kodshai (קודשי). The vocalized Hebrew of Horayot has Kudshai (קדשי).
[Heilprin’s Yaakov Korshai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2083&lang=en) also reports a ben Korshai form and cites the Horayot episode.
